units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 989:8">Yalk. Koh. 989</cite> <he>מה רשו … חציף האי נ׳ וכ׳</he> wherein lies the power of that sheep (Israel), that it can feed among seventy bears (nations)? Said he, strong is the watchman that guards it against all of them.—Pl. <he>נְטוֹרִין</he>, <he>נְטוֹרַיָּיא</he>.

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 18:10">Targ. Y. Deut. XVIII, 10</cite> <he>נְטוֹרֵי נחשין</he> (ed. Amst. <he>נַטּ׳</he>) observers of omens (h. text <cite ref="M01762"><he>מנחש</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 42:6">Targ. Y. Gen. XLII, 6</cite> (not <he>נְטוּ׳</he>); a. e.—Y. Ḥag. I, 76ᶜ <he>אייתון לן נְטוֹרֵי קרתא</he> bring before us the guards of the town; Lam. R. introd. (R. Abba 2); <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 127:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXXVII</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 881:3">Yalk. Ps. 881</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 881:3">ib.</cite> <he>אילין נ׳ קרתא וכ׳</he> are these the guardians of the town? They are the destroyers &c.
